criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Add a viewable complete backup history/status/count/time surface to the admin backend.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: Admins see whether each complete backup succeeded or failed, how many exist, and when; records are safe (no S3 credentials or backup payload content).
criteriaCoverage.userOutcomeReview: Backend records each complete backup export as a background task run (succeeded and failed paths tested), exposes a read-only admin-only backup-runs endpoint with exact task_key filtering and a safe response whitelist, and the System Settings page renders the latest status/count/time plus empty/error states and refreshes after a successful export.
